text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH 5xx rate detected for tenant=mistralbank in vpc=us-west-2 pool=dedi-usw2-3. Impact ~30% 5xx, elevated p95. Trigger: 5xx >10% over 1m. Runbook: /runbooks/mistralbank-vpc-fallback. Paginated to @Leo (oncall).

Leo (oncall): Ack. Investigating. @Anya can you join? Paging SRE.

Anya (SRE): I'm on. Quick look at logs shows repeated inference timeouts and 500s originating from kernel-selector path. Heavy KV-cache churn for long-contexts. Do we isolate the tenant first?

Leo (oncall): Yes - traffic on dedi-usw2-3. Recommend soft-evict: pin to safe-variant (mistralbank-sv-v2) + canary, avoid full rollback unless needed.

Mike (Infra): Noted. We can add a tenant override route. Any need for a quarantine slice?

Sara (AE - MistralBank): MistralBank's SRE is reachable; they've noticed degraded outputs and latency. They'll prefer a quick conservative change.

Anya (SRE): Plan: 1) Canary 10% to safe variant mistralbank-sv-v2. 2) If stable -> 100%. 3) Put noisy nodes into quarantine slice. Config snippet to apply: 

```json
{
  "tenant": "mistralbank",
  "action": "pin",
  "model": "mistralbank-sv-v2",
  "mode": "canary",
  "canary_pct": 10,
  "reason": "emergency fallback due to 5xx spike"
}
```

Leo (oncall): Runbook step 3: set tenant_isolation=true and route to reserved/quarantine pool if noise persists. Mike, can you provision quarantine?

Mike (Infra): Spinning up quarantine slice quarantine-mistral-176888 on dedi-usw2-3. ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: Action logged: incident_id=INC-2026-176888. Incident channel created.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll ping the customer and request sign-off for canary.

Sara (AE - MistralBank): Customer prefers no model-change if possible but approves canary to restore service.

Anya (SRE): Applying override: 

`/admin/override create --tenant mistralbank --model mistralbank-sv-v2 --percent 10 --duration 15m --note "emergency canary"`

Leo (oncall): Override applied. Observability watchers set: 5xx, p95, token retries. Suppressing noisy alerting to avoid alert storms.

Anya (SRE): Canary metrics after 3m: canary 5xx=0.5%, overall 5xx down from 30% -> 6%. p95 improved 220ms -> 180ms. Looks healthy.

Mike (Infra): Quarantine slice ready. Moving suspect nodes to quarantine-mistral-176888 and detaching from main pool.

Priya (Customer Success): Customer confirms canary OK and requests full rollout.

Leo (oncall): Rolling canary to 100% now.

Anya (SRE): Roll complete. 5xx at 0.8%, latency stable. Marking incident mitigated. Will observe for 30m before close.

Sara (AE - MistralBank): Thanks team — please produce a short RCA and timeline for the customer.

Anya (SRE): Preliminary RCA: kernel-selector mismatch with newest quantized variant under long-context workloads caused KV-cache thrash and timeouts. Immediate mitigation: pin to quantization-compatible safe-variant and quarantine noisy nodes. Follow-ups: patch kernel selector, add long-context perf tests, and add automatic safe-variant fallback on 5xx spikes. Notes saved to INC-2026-176888.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated by Anya (SRE). Close time recorded: 1768881499. Summary persisted to /incidents/INC-2026-176888/summary.md.

Leo (oncall): Good work all. :thumbsup:
